subject: Portal conformance gate: exceptions for PO/ACK & conditional clause clearance
messages:

Subject: Redwood portal enrollment & contract redline questions

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again — we're ready to start vendor enrollment in Ariba but legal flagged a few items in the MSA (attached). Specifically:

- Section 4.2: Northbridge needs PO-ack within 72 hours; your standard is 5 business days — can we get a firm SLA?
- Section 7.1: Data retention language—we need 7 years for auditability; your clause references 3 years.
- Order Form: EDI field "BuyerAccountCode" is mandatory for our POs; we need to confirm field mapping and EDI ACK window.

We're happy to run the portal mapping in parallel but legal asked that redline exceptions be annotated so their procurement team can sign off before we hit Ariba. Attached: Redline_MSA_v3.pdf and an initial PO field spec.

Can you confirm who's the internal owner for legal review on this? Also, any known workarounds on the PO ACK SLA or field mapping so we can keep the onboarding timeline?

Thanks,
Ella Hartman
Senior Procurement Manager
Northbridge Health

Hi Ella — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (Ops) for the PO/EDI mapping details and Marissa (Legal) to triage the redlines. Quick notes while we sync:

- PO ACK SLA: Our default is 5 business days for manual flows; for Ariba/Coupa-connected vendors we can configure a 72-hour ACK policy if the vendor can support automatic EDI 855 acknowledgements. Ops, can you confirm if Northbridge's EDI partner supports 855 and how long the mapping/contract change will take?
- Retention: I’ve asked Legal to review the 7-year ask and provide options (contract amendment vs. customer-specific addendum).
- BuyerAccountCode: Kimberly — I attached the PO field matrix for your review; if mapping is straightforward we can mark this as "supported with field map" and proceed with portal enrollment.

Proposed next step: 30-min call tomorrow to align legal + ops + procurement and lock the timeline for portal activation.

Thanks,

Hi all,

I dug into the PO field matrix and chatted with Integrations. Short answers:

- BuyerAccountCode: supported. We currently map it to vendor_account_id in our schema. Minimal transform.
- EDI ACK (855): Northbridge's ERP partner needs to send 855 to our gateway. We can provision that in the Coupa/Ariba bridge; expect ~5 business days for mapping + test window.
- PO ACK SLA: We can enforce a 72-hr expectation for automated ACKs (if 855 is live). For manual/offline vendors our system will keep 5 business day default. We can add an exception clause in the order form that pins 72-hr ACK for this account once 855 is confirmed.

I'll prepare a short enrollment playbook and a test plan for the mapping. Suggest we keep legal exceptions minimal: annotate the redlines with alternatives and call out which items are conditional on successful EDI 855 provisioning.

Kimberly Park
Onboarding Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood portal enrollment & contract redline questions

Hi team,

Thanks for the context. I reviewed Redline_MSA_v3 and propose the following path so procurement can proceed without blocking the portal onboarding: 

1) Data retention (Section 7.1): Offer a customer-specific addendum committing to 7 years for audit logs tied to Northbridge PII/PHI, with standard delete/retention elsewhere at 3 years. This keeps the master MSA unchanged.
2) PO ACK SLA / 72-hr clause: Acceptable if we include a conditional sentence in the order form: "72-hour PO acknowledgment applies where automated EDI 855 acknowledgements are successfully provisioned; otherwise standard acknowledgment terms apply."
3) Indemnity/limitation tweaks in Section 10: propose soft language preserving our capped liability but add a carve-out for gross negligence—redline attached with tracked changes.

I will prepare a one-page exceptions summary that procurement can attach to the portal registration (helps their approvers). If Northbridge agrees to the conditional clause above we'll mark the legal redline as accepted pending EDI verification.

I can join the call tomorrow at 10am PT.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
